## gh auth login
Authenticate `gh` with a GitHub account — browser flow, device code, or PAT — and store the credential securely in the system keyring.

## gh auth
Manage GitHub CLI authentication — log in, log out, inspect token scopes, and switch active accounts across multiple GitHub hosts and identities.

## gh auth refresh
Expand, shrink, or reset the OAuth scopes on the active account's stored token — opens a browser re-auth flow to apply the change.

## gh issue create
Open a new GitHub Issue with title, body, labels, assignees, milestone, and project — fully non-interactively from the command line.

## gh issue develop
Create a branch that is server-side linked to a GitHub Issue — making the branch visible in the issue's "Development" panel — and optionally check it out locally in one step.

## gh issue
Create, browse, and manage GitHub Issues from the terminal — the entry point to every issue workflow.

## gh label
Create, list, edit, delete, and clone labels across GitHub repositories.

## gh pr create
Open a new pull request on GitHub from the current (or a specified) branch.

## gh pr merge
Merge (or squash-merge, or rebase-merge) a pull request and optionally delete its branch.

## gh pr
Create, review, and manage GitHub pull requests from the command line.

## gh pr review
Submit an approval, a "request changes" review, or a plain comment review on a pull request — without opening a browser.
